llama-cpp-cve.title: llama.cpp LLM Inference Engine Vulnerability Research (3 CVEs)
llama-cpp-cve.background: LLM inference engines are being adopted quickly into in-house and product infrastructure, yet the attack surface exposed in server mode had received little scrutiny. Targeting the external-input paths of the llama.cpp server (grammar conversion, model parser, ranking API), verified the feasibility of remote unauthenticated attacks.
actions: Analyzed uncontrolled recursion in json-schema-to-grammar SchemaConverter::visit and _generate_union_rule - reproduced DoS by exhausting the default 8MB thread stack at recursion depth 7000 or more (CVE-2026-52130, CWE-674, CVSS 7.5)

Verified the affected path precisely - confirmed that only POST /completions is affected while /v1/chat/completions is not (it goes through the jinja engine), yielding a false-positive-free impact scope
Triggered process abort via a reachable assertion in gguf_reader::read when loading a malicious GGUF model (CVE-2026-52131, CWE-617)
Identified a DoS based on integer overflow from a negative top_n on the /rerank endpoint and wrote a PoC (CVE-2026-52132, CWE-190)
results: Assigned 3 CVEs against llama.cpp - CVE-2026-52130 / 52131 / 52132
Included 2 remote unauthenticated DoS issues (CVSS 7.5); provided upstream with reproduction steps that distinguish vulnerable from non-vulnerable paths
